barks.text: Hmm... the Weaver's thread has pulled tight, hasn't it, after all these winters?
Tell me, Saria, do you see the comet's tail stretching as far as the Dragon's eye this eve?
Mm, does a falling star truly fall, or merely choose a new path through the dark?
These old charts... do they truly show the Wanderer's true path, dear Elara, or only echoes?
The Twin Serpents... will they align as they did ten winters past, eh, Lyra?
Mm, the Eye of the Serpent... it shows a curious flicker tonight, my old friend.
Mm, this ancient chart, showing a comet's return within two winters, suggests a precise convergence.
These ancient charts... do they truly show us what we seek, or merely what we expect?
